era: PS2 / PS3 / Wii / Xbox 360 rhythm peripheral
summary: Activision and FreeStyleGames' turntable-controller rhythm spin-off of Guitar Hero, centered on mashups, scratching, crossfading, and party multiplayer.

entries.title: DJ Hero

emulation.notes: Peripheral support is the limiting factor; use original hardware and controller when possible.

primary.version: HD console release with turntable controller
primary.why: DJ Hero shipped on PS2, PS3, Wii, and Xbox 360; the HD console versions are the best main routes, and Xbox 360 is the single selected primary for a modern capture setup with the required turntable peripheral.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 version with the DJ Hero turntable controller. Use PS3 as an equivalent HD fallback if that is where the controller/software are available; avoid PS2/Wii unless collecting platform coverage.

entries.title: DJ Hero 2

emulation.notes: Peripheral support and rhythm latency make original hardware the preferred route.

primary.version: HD console release with turntable controller
primary.why: DJ Hero 2 released on PS3, Wii, and Xbox 360, adds freestyle sections, Empire mode, expanded multiplayer, vocals, and 83 remixes; the Xbox 360 HD version is the selected primary capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 version with the DJ Hero turntable controller. Use PS3 as an equivalent HD fallback if controller access is better there; use Wii only for platform coverage.
